description: This file contains test cases for the TtsConfigSchema using the Vitest testing framework. It verifies that the schema correctly accepts valid configurations and rejects invalid ones related to 'speed' and 'instructions' settings within the 'openai' provider.

methods.name: describe
methods.description: Defines a test suite for TtsConfigSchema related to openai speed and instructions.

methods.name: expect
methods.description: Creates assertions to verify the behavior of TtsConfigSchema.parse

methods.name: it
methods.description: Defines individual test cases for accepting or rejecting specific configurations.
